# Settings block

> Account and preference pages.

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-ai-docs.mjs (npm run gen:ai). Do not edit by hand. -->

Install doc for the **Settings block** of ui-kit: 1 variant built only from ui-kit components. React >=18.2 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4.

## Instructions for the AI agent

Add the Settings block to this project exactly as specified here. If the user did not say which variant, ask, or install the first one.

1. **Setup first.** Look for `ui/styles/kit.css` in the folder the `@/` import alias points to (`src/` in most Next.js apps, otherwise the project root). If it is missing, apply the one-time setup first: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/setup.md
2. **Install these components first**, in this order, skipping any already in `ui/components/`. Follow each one's doc, or run the download script below, which covers all of them:
   - `alert`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/alert.md
   - `avatar`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/avatar.md
   - `badge`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/badge.md
   - `button`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/button.md
   - `dialog`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/dialog.md
   - `field`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/field.md
   - `input`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/input.md
   - `native-select`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/native-select.md
   - `progress`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/progress.md
   - `radio-group`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/radio-group.md
   - `separator`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/separator.md
   - `switch`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/switch.md

   - `textarea`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/textarea.md
3. **Shared files.** Create the files under [Shared files](#shared-files) at their exact paths (the download script covers them).
4. **Register the CSS.** In `ui/styles/kit.css`, add these lines directly above the `@source` line, skipping any already there:

   ```css
   @import "./components/alert.css";
   @import "./components/avatar.css";
   @import "./components/badge.css";
   @import "./components/button.css";
   @import "./components/dialog.css";
   @import "./components/field.css";
   @import "./components/input.css";
   @import "./components/native-select.css";
   @import "./components/progress.css";
   @import "./components/radio-group.css";
   @import "./components/separator.css";
   @import "./components/switch.css";
   @import "./components/table.css";
   @import "./components/tabs.css";
   @import "./components/textarea.css";
   ```

5. **Create the block.** Save the variant verbatim as its own file, for example `components/blocks/settings/<variant>.tsx` inside the `@/` folder, then render it from a page. Change the copy (names, prices, links) only if the user asks.

**Rules.** Copy every file verbatim: do not restyle, rename classes, reformat, "improve", convert to another styling approach (CSS modules, styled-components, inline styles) or add npm packages. React and Tailwind CSS v4 only. Keep `'use client'` lines where they are. If a file already exists with identical contents, leave it. Fetch this doc and the source files as raw text (for example with `curl`), not through a summarising web reader: the code must arrive character for character.

## Specification

### Block: Settings

An account and workspace settings page: a header, then sidebar tabs (Account, Notifications, Billing, Danger zone) with one panel at a time. Built only from ui-kit components plus Tailwind utilities, in one self-contained client component file.

#### Anatomy
```
root                       @container, rounded-xl, 1px border, bg-background, overflow-hidden; ResizeObserver decides the layout
  header                   border-bottom, px 20 → 32 (wide), py 20: h1 “Settings” 24px/600 + muted lead
  Tabs variant="underline" orientation = wide ? vertical : horizontal   (wide = block width ≥ 672px)
    TabsList               aria-label “Settings sections”; wide: 12rem column with the indicator on its right edge;
                           narrow: a scrolling row with 20px side margins
      TabsTrigger × 4      Icon (user, bell, credit-card, triangle-alert) + label; the danger tab turns destructive-text when active
    TabsContent × 4        direct children of Tabs; wide: max-width 42rem; narrow: 20px side margins
```

Panels (each starts with an h2 20px/600 + muted 14px description):
- **Account** — `Form` (noValidate, gap 24px): Avatar xl + “Upload photo” (outline sm, upload icon) + “Remove” (ghost sm) + hint; Full name / Display name in two columns from @xl; Email read-only with a success Badge “Verified”; Bio `Textarea` (rows 3, maxLength 160, showCount); Time zone `NativeSelect`; save bar.
- **Notifications** — h3 “Email” section: `Switch` rows with label + description, `labelPosition="start"` (switch on the right); one disabled-on row “Billing receipts”. `Separator`. h3 “Push notifications”: `RadioGroup` with three items (label + description). Save bar “Save preferences”.
- **Billing** — bordered box: “Pro plan” + success Badge with dot “Active”, price and renewal line, “Cancel plan” (outline) + “Upgrade to Business” (primary); Separator; Seats and Storage `Progress` meters (tone warning at ≥ 80%) in two columns from @xl. Bordered row: card brand chip, “Visa ending in 4242”, “Update card”. h3 “Invoices” + `Table` (Invoice, Date, Amount numeric, Status Badge “Paid”, icon download button with aria-label).
- **Danger zone** — one rounded box with a destructive/40 border and dividers: Transfer ownership (outline), Export all data (outline, download icon), Delete workspace (title in destructive-text, destructive button).

Save bar: top border, right-aligned; a role="status" slot showing check + “Saved” in success-text, then the submit Button.

#### Behaviour
- Save: the button shows `loading` for ~0.9s, then “Saved” appears; the next change or click in that form clears it.
- Account validates the name on submit: “Enter your name. It’s shown on comments and invoices.” and focuses the field.
- Delete workspace opens `Dialog` with `role="alertdialog"`, size sm. The confirm input (autoFocus) must equal the workspace slug exactly before “Delete workspace” enables; while deleting, the dialog is not dismissible and Cancel is disabled. Closing clears the input. Afterwards a warning `Alert` (“Workspace scheduled for deletion”) with a “Restore workspace” link appears above the box and the delete button is disabled.
- Tabs: automatic activation, arrow keys follow the current orientation; the panel rises in only after the first change.

#### Visual rules
- Semantic tokens only; no gradients; no shadows except the dialog.
- Section titles h2 20px/600 display font; group titles h3 15px/600.
- Boxes: rounded-xl, 1px border, 20px padding.

#### Responsive
- Wide (≥ 672px of block width): vertical tabs on the left, content on the right. Narrow: horizontal scrolling tabs above the content. Two-column field rows collapse to one below @xl (36rem).
- Works from 360px: action buttons wrap under their text.

#### Accessibility
- WAI-ARIA tabs with aria-orientation matching the layout; each panel is labelled by its tab.
- Groups are `<section aria-labelledby>`; the RadioGroup is labelled by its h3.
- Disabled switch explains itself in its description. Icon-only buttons have aria-labels.

#### Acceptance checks
- At 1024px the tab list is vertical; at 390px it is a horizontal row and the panel sits under it.
- Clearing Full name and saving shows the error; a valid save shows “Saved”.
- In the delete dialog the button stays disabled until “northwind-finance” is typed.

### Settings with sidebar tabs

File: `components/blocks/settings/sidebar-tabs.tsx` (docs source: `apps/docs/examples/blocks/settings/sidebar-tabs.tsx`)

```tsx
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { Alert, AlertDescription, AlertTitle } from '@/ui/components/alert';
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from '@/ui/components/avatar';
import { Badge } from '@/ui/components/badge';
import { Button } from '@/ui/components/button';
import { Dialog, DialogClose, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogFooter, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogTrigger } from '@/ui/components/dialog';
import { Field, FieldError, FieldHint, Form, Label } from '@/ui/components/field';
import { Input } from '@/ui/components/input';
import { NativeSelect } from '@/ui/components/native-select';
import { Progress } from '@/ui/components/progress';
import { RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem } from '@/ui/components/radio-group';
import { Separator } from '@/ui/components/separator';
import { Switch } from '@/ui/components/switch';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@/ui/components/table';
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@/ui/components/tabs';
import { Textarea } from '@/ui/components/textarea';
import { Icon, type IconName } from '@/ui/icons/icon';

const SECTIONS: { value: string; label: string; icon: IconName }[] = [
  { value: 'account', label: 'Account', icon: 'user' },
  { value: 'notifications', label: 'Notifications', icon: 'bell' },
  { value: 'billing', label: 'Billing', icon: 'credit-card' },
  { value: 'danger', label: 'Danger zone', icon: 'triangle-alert' },
];

const WORKSPACE = 'northwind-finance';

/** Vertical tabs when the block is wide enough, a scrolling row of tabs when it isn't. */
function useWide<T extends HTMLElement>(min: number) {
  const ref = useRef<T>(null);
  const [wide, setWide] = useState(true);
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el || typeof ResizeObserver === 'undefined') return;
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(([entry]) => setWide(entry!.contentRect.width >= min));
    ro.observe(el);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, [min]);
  return [ref, wide] as const;
}

/** Fake request: resolves after a short delay so loading states are visible. */
function useSave() {
  const [state, setState] = useState<'idle' | 'saving' | 'saved'>('idle');
  const save = () => {
    setState('saving');
    setTimeout(() => setState('saved'), 900);
  };
  return { state, save, reset: () => state === 'saved' && setState('idle') };
}

function PanelHeader({ title, description }: { title: string; description: string }) {
  return (
    <header className="grid gap-1">
      <h2 className="font-display text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight">{title}</h2>
      <p className="text-base text-muted-foreground">{description}</p>
    </header>
  );
}

function SaveBar({ state, label = 'Save changes' }: { state: 'idle' | 'saving' | 'saved'; label?: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-3 border-t border-border pt-4">
      <span role="status" className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm text-success-text">
        {state === 'saved' && (
          <>
            <Icon name="check" size={16} />
            Saved
          </>
        )}
      </span>
      <Button type="submit" loading={state === 'saving'}>
        {label}
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}

function AccountPanel() {
  const { state, save, reset } = useSave();
  const [nameError, setNameError] = useState<string>();
  const submit = (e: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const input = e.currentTarget.elements.namedItem('name') as HTMLInputElement;
    if (!input.value.trim()) {
      setNameError('Enter your name. It’s shown on comments and invoices.');
      input.focus();
      return;
    }
    save();
  };
  return (
    <Form noValidate onSubmit={submit} onChange={reset} aria-label="Profile" className="gap-6">
      <PanelHeader title="Profile" description="This is how teammates see you across Lumen." />
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
        <Avatar size="xl">
          <AvatarFallback>AL</AvatarFallback>
        </Avatar>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm">
            <Icon name="upload" />
            Upload photo
          </Button>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">
            Remove
          </Button>
        </div>
        <p className="w-full text-sm text-muted-foreground">PNG or JPG, at least 256 × 256px.</p>
      </div>
      <div className="grid gap-4 @xl:grid-cols-2">
        <Field invalid={!!nameError}>
          <Label>Full name</Label>
          <Input name="name" autoComplete="name" defaultValue="Ada Lovelace" onChange={() => setNameError(undefined)} />
          <FieldError>{nameError}</FieldError>
        </Field>
        <Field>
          <Label>Display name</Label>
          <Input name="handle" defaultValue="ada" />
          <FieldHint>Used for @mentions.</FieldHint>
        </Field>
      </div>
      <Field>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Label>Email</Label>
          <Badge variant="success" size="sm">
            Verified
          </Badge>
        </div>
        <Input name="email" type="email" defaultValue="ada@northwind.com" readOnly />
        <FieldHint>To change your email, contact your workspace owner.</FieldHint>
      </Field>
      <Field>
        <Label>Bio</Label>
        <Textarea name="bio" rows={3} maxLength={160} showCount defaultValue="Finance lead. I keep the monthly close on schedule." />
      </Field>
      <Field>
        <Label>Time zone</Label>
        <NativeSelect name="tz" defaultValue="Europe/London">
          <option value="America/Los_Angeles">Pacific Time (UTC−08:00)</option>
          <option value="America/New_York">Eastern Time (UTC−05:00)</option>
          <option value="Europe/London">London (UTC+00:00)</option>
          <option value="Europe/Berlin">Berlin (UTC+01:00)</option>
          <option value="Asia/Kolkata">India (UTC+05:30)</option>
        </NativeSelect>
      </Field>
      <SaveBar state={state} />
    </Form>
  );
}

const EMAIL_PREFS = [
  { name: 'mentions', label: 'Mentions and replies', description: 'When someone @mentions you or replies to your comment.', on: true },
  { name: 'approvals', label: 'Approval requests', description: 'Expenses and invoices waiting for your sign-off.', on: true },
  { name: 'digest', label: 'Weekly digest', description: 'A Monday summary of spend, runway and open tasks.', on: false },
  { name: 'product', label: 'Product updates', description: 'New features and improvements, about once a month.', on: false },
];

function NotificationsPanel() {
  const { state, save, reset } = useSave();
  return (
    <Form
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        save();
      }}
      onClick={reset}
      aria-label="Notifications"
      className="gap-6"
    >
      <PanelHeader title="Notifications" description="Choose what reaches your inbox and your phone." />
      <section className="grid gap-4" aria-labelledby="notify-email">
        <h3 id="notify-email" className="text-md font-semibold">
          Email
        </h3>
        {EMAIL_PREFS.map((p) => (
          <Switch key={p.name} name={p.name} defaultChecked={p.on} label={p.label} description={p.description} labelPosition="start" />
        ))}
        <Switch name="receipts" defaultChecked disabled label="Billing receipts" description="Always on while your workspace is on a paid plan." labelPosition="start" />
      </section>
      <Separator />
      <section className="grid gap-4" aria-labelledby="notify-push">
        <h3 id="notify-push" className="text-md font-semibold">
          Push notifications
        </h3>
        <RadioGroup name="push" defaultValue="mentions" aria-labelledby="notify-push">
          <RadioGroupItem value="all" label="All new activity" description="Comments, approvals and status changes in projects you follow." />
          <RadioGroupItem value="mentions" label="Mentions and direct messages" description="Only things addressed to you." />
          <RadioGroupItem value="none" label="Nothing" description="You’ll still see everything in the inbox." />
        </RadioGroup>
      </section>
      <SaveBar state={state} label="Save preferences" />
    </Form>
  );
}

function BillingPanel() {
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-6">
      <PanelHeader title="Billing" description="Your plan, usage and invoices. Prices exclude VAT." />
      <div className="grid gap-4 rounded-xl border border-border p-5">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="grid gap-1">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <h3 className="text-md font-semibold">Pro plan</h3>
              <Badge variant="success" size="sm" dot>
                Active
              </Badge>
            </div>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">$24 per seat / month · renews on Dec 12, 2026</p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm">
              Cancel plan
            </Button>
            <Button size="sm">Upgrade to Business</Button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <Separator />
        <div className="grid gap-5 @xl:grid-cols-2">
          {[
            { label: 'Seats', used: 8, max: 10, text: '8 of 10' },
            { label: 'Storage', used: 82.6, max: 100, text: '82.6 of 100 GB' },

                <span className="text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">{m.text}</span>

              <Progress value={m.used} max={m.max} tone={m.used / m.max >= 0.8 ? 'warning' : 'default'} aria-label={`${m.label} used`} getValueText={() => m.text} />
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-border p-5">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <span className="grid h-8 w-12 place-items-center rounded-md border border-border bg-muted text-xs font-semibold">VISA</span>
          <div className="grid text-sm">
            <span className="font-medium">Visa ending in 4242</span>
            <span className="text-muted-foreground">Expires 08/2028 · billing@northwind.com</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <Button variant="outline" size="sm">
          Update card
        </Button>
      </div>
      <div className="grid gap-3">
        <h3 className="text-md font-semibold">Invoices</h3>
        <Table label="Invoices">
          <TableHeader>
            <TableRow>
              <TableHead>Invoice</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Date</TableHead>
              <TableHead numeric>Amount</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
              <TableHead>
                <span className="sr-only">Download</span>
              </TableHead>
            </TableRow>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {INVOICES.map((inv) => (
              <TableRow key={inv.id}>
                <TableCell className="font-medium whitespace-nowrap">{inv.id}</TableCell>
                <TableCell className="whitespace-nowrap">{inv.date}</TableCell>
                <TableCell numeric>{inv.amount}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  <Badge variant="secondary" size="sm">

                  </Badge>

                <TableCell align="right">
                  <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" icon aria-label={`Download ${inv.id}`}>
                    <Icon name="download" />
                  </Button>
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function DangerPanel() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState('');
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);
  const [scheduled, setScheduled] = useState(false);

  const remove = () => {
    setDeleting(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setDeleting(false);
      setOpen(false);
      setScheduled(true);
    }, 1200);
  };

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-6">
      <PanelHeader title="Danger zone" description="Actions here are permanent or hard to undo. Take a moment." />
      {scheduled && (
        <Alert variant="warning" role="alert">
          <AlertTitle>Workspace scheduled for deletion</AlertTitle>
          <AlertDescription>
            {WORKSPACE} and its data will be deleted on Dec 25, 2026. Until then you can restore it.{' '}
            <Button variant="link" size="sm" className="h-auto px-0" onClick={() => setScheduled(false)}>
              Restore workspace
            </Button>
          </AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      )}
      <div className="divide-y divide-border rounded-xl border border-destructive/40">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 p-5">
          <div className="grid max-w-md gap-1">
            <h3 className="text-md font-semibold">Transfer ownership</h3>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Make another admin the owner. You stay on as an admin.</p>
          </div>
          <Button variant="outline">Transfer</Button>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 p-5">
          <div className="grid max-w-md gap-1">
            <h3 className="text-md font-semibold">Export all data</h3>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">A ZIP of every ledger, invoice and attachment, emailed to you.</p>
          </div>
          <Button variant="outline">
            <Icon name="download" />
            Export
          </Button>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 p-5">
          <div className="grid max-w-md gap-1">
            <h3 className="text-md font-semibold text-destructive-text">Delete workspace</h3>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Deletes {WORKSPACE}, its 14 members’ access and 3 years of records after 30 days.</p>
          </div>
          <Dialog
            open={open}
            onOpenChange={(next) => {
              setOpen(next);
              if (!next) setConfirm('');
            }}
          >
            <DialogTrigger asChild>
              <Button variant="destructive" disabled={scheduled}>
                Delete workspace
              </Button>
            </DialogTrigger>
            <DialogContent role="alertdialog" size="sm" dismissible={!deleting}>
              <DialogHeader>
                <DialogTitle>Delete {WORKSPACE}?</DialogTitle>
                <DialogDescription>Everyone loses access right away. The data is deleted for good after 30 days.</DialogDescription>
              </DialogHeader>
              <Field>
                <Label>
                  Type <span className="font-mono font-semibold">{WORKSPACE}</span> to confirm
                </Label>
                <Input value={confirm} onChange={(e) => setConfirm(e.target.value)} autoComplete="off" spellCheck={false} autoFocus />
              </Field>
              <DialogFooter>
                <DialogClose asChild>
                  <Button variant="outline" disabled={deleting}>
                    Cancel
                  </Button>
                </DialogClose>
                <Button variant="destructive" loading={deleting} disabled={confirm !== WORKSPACE} onClick={remove}>
                  Delete workspace
                </Button>
              </DialogFooter>
            </DialogContent>
          </Dialog>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function SettingsSidebarTabs() {
  const [ref, wide] = useWide<HTMLDivElement>(672);
  const panel = wide ? 'max-w-2xl' : 'mx-5';
  return (
    <div ref={ref} className="@container w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-border bg-background">
      <div className="border-b border-border px-5 py-5 @2xl:px-8">
        <h1 className="font-display text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">Settings</h1>
        <p className="text-base text-muted-foreground">Manage your profile, notifications and the Northwind Finance workspace.</p>
      </div>
      <Tabs
        defaultValue="account"
        variant="underline"
        orientation={wide ? 'vertical' : 'horizontal'}
        className={wide ? 'gap-8 px-8 py-6' : 'gap-5 py-4'}
      >
        <TabsList aria-label="Settings sections" className={wide ? 'w-48' : 'mx-5'}>
          {SECTIONS.map((s) => (
            <TabsTrigger key={s.value} value={s.value} className={s.value === 'danger' ? 'data-[state=active]:text-destructive-text' : undefined}>
              <Icon name={s.icon} />
              {s.label}
            </TabsTrigger>
          ))}
        </TabsList>
        <TabsContent value="account" className={panel}>
          <AccountPanel />
        </TabsContent>
        <TabsContent value="notifications" className={panel}>
          <NotificationsPanel />
        </TabsContent>
        <TabsContent value="billing" className={panel}>
          <BillingPanel />
        </TabsContent>
        <TabsContent value="danger" className={panel}>
          <DangerPanel />
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```
